title: Pure Crusadia
summary: Crusadia cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Every Crusadia Main Deck monster summons itself from the hand into a zone one of your Link Monsters points to, and the Crusadia Links gain the ATK of what they point to. Normal Summon a Crusadia, turn it into Crusadia Magius, and Magius searches a Crusadia monster whenever a monster is summoned into its zone. Crusadia Regulex does the same for Crusadia Spells/Traps. Crusadia Reclusia destroys one of your Crusadia cards and one of theirs when it lands in a linked zone, and Crusadia Draco recovers a Crusadia card. Crusadia Equimax tributes a linked Crusadia to negate a card on either turn. Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax, the newest card (2019), stops targeting and draws every attack. Crusadia Testament, from the same set, stops responses to your Crusadia effects. Crusadia Krawler is left out, since it searches World Legacy cards.
